course_title: Freshman Seminar: Connecting Mind to Moving Body
subject: DANC
course_description: An introductory seminar on a special topic in dance and movement studies.
course_notes: (Freshmen Seminar - Limited to First Year Students Only) (Connecting the Mind to the Moving Body will present an experiential overview of different somatic practices (i.e. Alexander, Ideokinesis, Bartenieff Fundamentals, and core support techniques). All of these somatic forms require attention to breathing, alignment, proprioception, core support, sequencing and flexibility. Students will explore the interconnectedness of body and mind while focusing on the ways that somatic practices inform and intertwine with one's intellectual life, cultural identity, and embodied life experiences. Body knowledge will expand from guest movement teachers, readings, discussions, a series of short papers and journaling. This course would be a great choice for any student who has a background in dance, yoga, tai chi, pilates or any movement form and is interested in different ways of looking at and experiencing movement. Students should come to class wearing loose clothing suitable for movement experiences.)
